newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise, other bunkers steady or weak.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise, other bunkers steady or weak.

text.p: ARA bunkers rose on Wednesday afternoon, but other bunker prices were steady to weak, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers traded at $98 and $99 fob in the morning, but by mid-afternoon a rising barge market had pushed prices up to $100 and above. Bunker 180 CST prices also rose by $2 from the morning. The market nevertheless saw reasonable business of around 10,000 tonnes as buyers, with essential shorts to cover, feared further rises were to come.
"The shipowners aren't at all happy, but they think prices may be higher tomorrow," one dealer said.
Hamburg prices were largely unchanged. Demand was very thin and supply good.

Mediterranean prices were steady to weak. Bunkers in southern France dropped $1 a tonne. Spanish prices were steady. However, dealers said the changes were immaterial since trading was minimal. Greek dealers, for example, cited just one order for the week, on Friday.
Durban prices were steady and stocks were relatively tight.
Brokers in the Middle East said activity could grow if, as expected, Iraqi oil exports begin soon.
